Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed +1.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2594@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for part part:360012 at EUR 4.91 per 100 units (po:4500014466-10, po:4500014414-10, po:4500014353-10).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.

As a distributor, our pricing reflects a composite of manufacturer costs, logistics, and service value, meaning we cannot provide an internal cost breakdown. Material accounts for about 61 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Please note that the historical purchase orders you referenced apply to a single component rather than this complete fastener kit bundle.

We welcome your proposal to extend the contract term to 24 months, which allows us to revise our offer to a price of €5.53 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.body: Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to move closer to a mutually beneficial agreement. It is always a pleasure working with you, and we value our shared business relationship highly.

To support your pricing goals, we are pleased to accept the 36-month contract term, which allows us to offer a further reduced price of €5.42 per unit. Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €5.42 per unit.

We believe this reflects a fair balance and secures long-term stability for both parties. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
